plan.title: Closed RFQ withdrawal requires a reason

steps.note: Open the existing prepared closed RFQ summary; the event is already created and bidding has ended.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required post-expiry surrogate-bid configuration.
Apply the required buyer bid-edit configuration.
Open the RFQ stage specified by the case.
Open the RFQ Responses tab before accessing the event actions.
Attempt project withdrawal with the reason deliberately left empty; this checks Procol's required-remark refusal and records the resulting validation or blocked action.
Assert that the application shows a validation or refusal message referring to the missing withdrawal reason.
